universal.notes: First ordinary Gef lesson. It teaches the level system used by books, learner profiles, placement, and future Gefstimates. Priority 0 is reserved for a future prerequisite-level orientation such as 'What is a language?' if Gef ever authors one; do not invent a placeholder lesson merely to fill zero.

Universal grammatical-gender comparison family. Spanish has full candidate rule/practice data; other languages participate only when this lesson has explicit comparison or full-support records. Do not infer capability from global language tier.

Family path stage 1: Core family. Pair-level session_depth determines Core versus Cultural. If either source or target role is Tier 3/comparison-only, show only the localized Core lesson and recognition-safe vocabulary/game material.

Family path stage 2: Describe your family. Starts with reusable sentence functions and separates household facts from kinship. Cultural analysis is available only when both active language roles satisfy the Family full-support contract.

Family path stage 3: Extended family. Core mode teaches relationship paths and safe matching; Cultural mode may add family-side, age, gender, affinity, address and register distinctions when both active language roles are full-support.

Family path stage 4: Relationships and family life. Covers dating/partner/marriage/separation/divorce vocabulary. Current 104-language Core vocabulary breadth is intentionally partial here until relationship-state vocabulary is expanded; do not fake missing translations.

A1 weekday-cycle lesson. All 104 current learn-from languages have short source/explanation blurbs; the current 21 Tier 1/Tier 2 languages have structured weekday systems and practice. Calendar first-day layout remains territory/locale context rather than a language fact.

A1 month-cycle lesson. All 104 current learn-from languages have short source/explanation blurbs; the current 21 Tier 1/Tier 2 languages have structured month systems and practice, including contextual alternate calendars, regional month systems, and grammatical date forms where reviewed data exists.

A1 season-vocabulary lesson. All 104 current learn-from languages have short source/explanation blurbs; the current 21 Tier 1/Tier 2 languages have structured season systems and practice. Hemisphere, climate, and traditional seasonal systems remain contextual instead of being inferred from a language tag.

path_policy.tier1: Build an ordered curriculum that may interleave lessons and story/chapter recommendations. Full grammar path is expected over time.
path_policy.tier2: Build a selective ordered curriculum that may interleave reviewed lessons and story/chapter recommendations when evidence supports them. Do not imply a complete grammar path.
path_policy.tier3: Reading and games remain the main learning path, but universal topical lessons may expose explicitly bounded Core sessions. Core availability must never be mistaken for full cultural or grammar-course support.
path_policy.next_resolution: After a lesson completes, prefer the next explicit item in the active language path. If no language-path successor exists, fall back to the next eligible universal catalog item by ascending priority. If neither exists, return to the originating lesson/dashboard context.
